title: The official standings page prints an inconsistent winning percentage
detail: Tennessee prints 1-8-0 with PCT 0.167 on the official page; 1/9 = 0.111. The printed value is stored verbatim and the derived value is used in correlations, with the discrepancy stated.

detail: Nine 'Out' and seven 'Questionable' cells are printed; the rest are blank. The blanks are the official print and are not filled from news copy or from another desk.

detail: Recorded verbatim, not corrected: Sauce Gardner under IND, Justin Fields under KC, Kenneth Walker III under KC, Mike Evans under SF, Malik Hooker under DAL, Jaylen Waddle under DEN, Geno Smith under NYJ. These are printed as such by the official page; if they are official errors, the source is wrong, not the transcription.

title: Two operators disagree by a full point on two totals and one spread
detail: ARI@KC: DraftKings 40.5, FanDuel 41.5. TB@DET: DraftKings 43.5, FanDuel 44.5. JAX@NYG: -6 vs -5.5. The consensus is a median, so a two-book median is a midpoint, not a market truth.

title: The pinned closing line is an aggregator quote with no operator and no timestamp
detail: The publisher does not name the book or the snapshot time. It is used as a benchmark and labelled AGGREGATOR everywhere; no claim is made that the model beat a specific book.

title: The pinned dataset's spread sign convention is not documented and is opposite to operator print
detail: Measured, not assumed: MAE of (actual home margin - spread_line) is 10.24 points versus 14.69 for the opposite sign over 5,201 games. Tables state the convention they use.

title: No server bytes or sha256 could be obtained from this sandbox
detail: nfl.com and the operator hosts are blocked at the TLS layer from here. Every in-session capture is text-level and says so. A scheduled GitHub job is committed to obtain byte-level captures with hashes.
status: OPEN — mitigated by the committed capture job

title: The model is behind the closing line and three strategies are significantly worse than it
detail: Brier skill -7.8% over 744 walk-forward games; S2 and S3 are significantly negative after multiplicity correction. Published as the headline, not buried.
status: OPEN — this is a result, not a defect

title: A desk claimed an availability graph built on official actives; the second side is not official
detail: The expected side (injury report) is official; the actual-participant side here is playing time from an aggregator. The join rate (68.2% of snap rows) is published so the claim can be sized.

detail: 347 (a full byte capture of the Week 10 page) versus 253 (today's Week 11 page, a different week). The counts are not comparable and are labelled by week and read stamp here.

detail: Week 10 was appended from the official page read today, so the corpus is one week fresher than the snapshot; the two sources are labelled per row.

title: corpus_games.csv was declared but never written
detail: build_corpus() returned the rows and main() never called write_corpus(), so the published corpus existed only as a summary count. Found by the verifier's row-count pin, not by inspection. Fixed: the table now publishes all 7,117 pinned games (952 usable) with a source link on every row.
status: RESOLVED — writer called, row count pinned at 7,117

title: The closing total sits 1.26 points below realised scoring
detail: Week-clustered CI 0.40-2.05 over 49 clusters, n=744; same sign in 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026, shrinking each year; not concentrated by total size. A mechanical every-over bet returns +0.33% on this sample. Treated as a market observation: the screen that found it used the holdout, which spends the holdout for this hypothesis. Any test must be pre-registered on 2026 games only with a frozen threshold.
status: OPEN — hypothesis only, not a strategy

title: A 0.72 dispersion fudge factor survived in the origination path
detail: The backtest was switched to a measured residual sd, but build_origination still scaled sigma_total by 0.72 to get a margin sd, and every originated side probability published earlier used it. Replaced with the measured residual sd of the margin; all 13 fair spreads and their probabilities are recomputed in the published table.
status: RESOLVED — measured sigma_margin carried in every row's input hash
